items.name: Vector Annunciator
items.depicts: A large black console framed in coral-red holding a six-by-four grid of dark red and lit yellow interrupt indicator tiles.

items.name: Priority Arbiter
items.depicts: A small black module bordered in coral-red containing four vertical bars alternating between dark red and bright yellow.

items.name: Trap Ledger
items.depicts: A grey-framed dark cabinet displaying four stacked horizontal bars, with the top entry lit coral-red above three amber rows.

items.name: Root Register
items.depicts: A yellow-bordered black register housing a deep red bar with a bright white rectangular core.

items.name: Unmaskable Flare
items.depicts: A glowing yellow starburst core encircled by a notched deep crimson ring on a short stem, resembling an urgent alarm beacon.

items.name: Busy Wheel
items.depicts: A hollow bright yellow pixel circle looping continuously around a solid coral-red square at its center.

items.name: Grace Period
items.depicts: Two identical dark rectangular panes side by side, the left bordered in bright cyan and the right bordered in bright yellow.

items.name: Stale Entry
items.depicts: A coral-red framed black box containing three vertical rectangular blocks, two dark red flanking a bright yellow middle slot.

items.name: Spurious Bug
items.depicts: A tiny red square with a single yellow core pixel and two short yellow side bars, occupying only a few pixels of a larger canvas.

items.name: Interrupt Spark
items.depicts: Three staggered square blocks—two yellow and one coral-red—forming a tiny zigzag spark floating in an empty canvas.
